name: mason-self
note: Self-benchmark: Mason benchmarked on its own codebase. Useful for harness smoke tests and dogfooding; numbers are NOT publishable (the repo's CLAUDE.md is unusually good, and the authors wrote both map and questions).

questions.question: Where does Mason compute drift, and where is the CI exit code decided? Name the exact files and briefly describe the split of responsibilities.
questions.criteria: Names src/drift/drift.ts as the drift computation (computeDrift, comparing the snapshot against git HEAD) and src/drift/cli.ts as the CLI that decides exit codes (0 fresh, 1 stale, 2 error). Correctly describes the split: drift.ts is the pure logic, cli.ts is arg parsing / summary / exit codes.

questions.question: Explain how Mason's Map-Reduce snapshot build works end to end: which MCP tools are involved at each step, and which source files implement each part?
questions.criteria: Describes the loop: generate_snapshot_batch returns file batches, save_partial_snapshot persists partials, reduce_snapshot returns partials for merging, save_snapshot persists the unified map. Names src/mcp/tools.ts as the tool implementations, src/snapshot/snapshot.ts for load/save/batching, src/snapshot/partials.ts for partials and the scope marker, src/snapshot/prompt.ts for the batch/reduce prompts. Bonus: mentions replace vs merge save modes or scoped refresh.

questions.question: I want to add a new MCP tool called mason_get_test_map that returns the test-to-source mapping. What files do I need to touch, what existing code should I reuse, and what project conventions apply?
questions.criteria: Identifies the three-place tool metadata sync: src/mcp/server.ts (Zod schema + registration), manifest.json, and the README tools table. Points at src/mcp/tools.ts for the implementation and src/test-map.ts (buildTestMap) as the code to reuse. Mentions relevant conventions: Zod schemas, ESM .js imports, conventional commits, and ideally whether the tool should be init-gated or read-only.

questions.question: What would be affected if I changed the Snapshot interface in src/snapshot/snapshot.ts — for example adding a required field to FeatureEntry? List the files that would need attention and why.
questions.criteria: Names the direct consumers: src/mcp/tools.ts (save/load/merge paths), src/drift/drift.ts (per-entry hash comparison), src/snapshot/partials.ts (partial merge), and the Confluence render path (src/confluence/renderer.ts and/or sync.ts, which read features/flows). Mentions tests that would need updating (test/tools.test.ts, test/drift.test.ts) and backward compatibility with existing snapshot.json files (version field / older maps).
